verdict.rationale: Sentry's public sandbox.sentry.io is described as a product-UI demo showroom pre-populated with sample data. The evidence explicitly says nothing documents it as an environment for testing API or agent calls, so it is an adjacent feature, not a test sandbox for this story. Self-hosting and MCP org/project scoping are user-side workarounds or adjacent controls, not a documented isolated test environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
